name: Sentinelle Errant
description: Sentinelle du dernier relais veillant sur les points de convergence stratégiques entre les zones de conflit.

subject.archetype: Sentinelle Errant — neutre Epic class eau

loadout.armor_outfit: Layered patched armor made from mismatched faction materials welded and stitched together, bullet-pocked shoulder plates, faded utility harness loaded with ammunition and tools forged from rare materials with faction crest embedded and energy pulsing through the entire surface with every movement
loadout.arsenal: Worn plasma rifle with taped grip sections and custom sight modifications, combat knife with notched blade, compact EMP grenades on belt The weapon and gauntlets actively channel the character's heal ability targeting damaged_friendly, visible energy conduits linking weapon to body with flowing power

attitude.behavior: Combat specialist engaged in the heat of battle with weapon and body fully committed to the fight. Compassionate reaching with healing tendrils specifically seeking wounded while bypassing healthy ones, showing visible triage intelligence in selective energy distribution
attitude.emotion: Apocalyptic fury — full weight of faction's power channeling through body uncontrollably

style.rendering_style: cinematic action photography with gritty realism, motion blur on projectiles and debris, sharp focus on character face and primary weapon, high contrast lighting with dramatic deep shadows

palette_names.name: Dusty Steel Gray
palette_names.role: primary_accent — weathered armor and tactical gear

palette_names.name: Warm Amber
palette_names.role: secondary_accent — muzzle flash and eye reflection

color_and_light.lighting_setup: amethyst alloy frame with crystalline energy channels pulsing light along border edges, explosive backlight from ability discharge, dramatic rim lighting separating character from environmental chaos, volumetric light rays cutting through smoke and particles

camera.angle: Wide dramatic low angle showing full blast radius, character backlit by their own power source, foreground devastated by ability effects

scenography.setting: Active warzone at an asteroid waystation crossroads under attack, plasma rounds impacting nearby corrugated walls sending debris and sparks raining down, allied forces taking cover behind makeshift barricades while enemy silhouettes advance through thick smoke
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Multiple precise healing streams finding wounded targets through battlefield clutter like guided missiles of life, each bypassing healthy allies to reach only those who need help, Only damaged areas respond to healing — cracked ground where wounded stand repairing while undamaged remains scarred, showing precision of targeted healing, Fine stellar dust swirling in air, muzzle flashes cutting through haze, shell casings ejecting in slow motion, debris kicked up by heavy boots, sparks ricocheting off metal surfaces
